headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty ended higher led by banking and pharma stocks; market closed today for holiday.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: Indian stock markets are closed on November 10 on account of Diwali Balipratipada.
In the previous session, banking and pharmaceutical stocks drove market gains.
PSU bank stocks performed strongly to support the benchmark indices in the last trade.
An oil price correction contributed to positive sentiment in Indian equities during the last session.
whatHappening: NSE and BSE are shut today for the scheduled Diwali Balipratipada trading holiday.
During the last session, Sensex closed above 81,000 while Nifty settled above 25,000.
L&T bagged an order valued between ₹1,000 crore and ₹2,500 crore for Noida Metro Aqua Line extension.
Trading operations across Indian exchanges will resume on Wednesday, 11 November.
summary:
Indian stock markets are closed today, 10 November, for Diwali Balipratipada.
On the last trading day, Sensex surpassed 81,000 and Nifty closed above 25,000 led by banking and pharma stocks.
Trading activity on BSE and NSE will resume on Wednesday, 11 November.
